observations.why: Directive phrasing carries urgency-as-worry: the cadence is being imposed as a corrective, signaling alarm that the current state is insufficient.
Aphoristic negation frames an unrehearsed rollback as effectively nonexistent — high-arousal alarm delivered through emphatic loss-framing.
Bulleted cadence line reads as settled administrative warmth — the decision is made, restated with low-arousal satisfaction.
Self-assignment of ownership is performed with low-arousal composure — a settled, confident acceptance of responsibility.

mints.title: a thing we have not tested is a thing we do not have
mints.frame: Is the speaker channeling urgency through a crystallized negation that frames absence-of-preparation as absence-of-capability?
